== Summary ==
Source image for [[Ng'ok War Beast (Virtual Set 1, Original)]]. The Set 1 preview face specifies characters in the loss-before-damage rule. Its blue Set 1 icon matches the early Modern release.<ref>[http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-large_images_postreset.tar.bz2 Holotable post-reset image archive], December 2014, member <code>cards/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/ngokwarbeast.gif</code>.</ref>
